profile_text: With a strong focus on veterinary care and pet supplies, this Düsseldorf-based business has experienced rapid growth, increasing its workforce by 90.9% to 21 employees in 2024. As a leading provider of animal health services and products in Germany, its success can be attributed to the rising demand for high-quality pet care and supplies. This growth has earned the company a "Gazelle" category designation, indicating its exceptional expansion and potential for continued success.
